PC-POL-012.explanation: Required insurance is 80 percent of $500,000, or $400,000. The insured carried $300,000, so $300,000 / $400,000 = 0.75 and the insurer pays 0.75 x $100,000 = $75,000. In North Carolina such a clause is valid only when "coinsurance contract" is printed on the policy (G.S. 58-3-15).

PC-AUTO-016.explanation: A vehicle is uninsured when there is no liability policy, the limits are below the state minimum, the insurer denies coverage or is insolvent, or the vehicle is a hit-and-run. North Carolina's G.S. 20-279.21(b)(3) includes the insolvent-insurer case, and equal limits make it insured, not uninsured.
